أستعجل (form X)
# أَسْتَعْجِلُ (ʔastaʕjilu) /ʔas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# أُسْتَعْجَلُ (ʔustaʕjalu) /ʔus.taʕ.d͡ʒa.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# أَسْتَعْجِلَ (ʔastaʕjila) /ʔas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# أُسْتَعْ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
